name: Neural Networks / Deep Learning
description: Neural Networks are computational models inspired by biological neurons. They consist of interconnected layers of nodes (neurons) that process information through weighted connections. Deep Learning refers to networks with many hidden layers that can learn hierarchical representations of data.

concept.perceptron: Basic unit: weighted sum of inputs + bias, passed through activation function
concept.forwardPropagation: Input flows through network: z = Wx + b, a = activation(z)
concept.backpropagation: Calculate gradients of loss w.r.t. weights using chain rule, update weights
concept.universalApproximation: Single hidden layer can approximate any continuous function (given enough neurons)
concept.deepAdvantage: Multiple layers learn hierarchical features automatically

avoidWhen: Tabular data with clear features (trees often better)

hiddenLayers.description: Number and size of hidden layers
hiddenLayers.impact: More/larger layers = more capacity but risk overfitting

activation.impact: ReLU common for hidden; Sigmoid/Softmax for output

learningRate.impact: Too high = unstable; too low = slow convergence

optimizer.impact: Adam most popular; SGD with momentum for large data

batchSize.impact: Larger = faster but less frequent updates

epochs.description: Number of complete passes through data
epochs.impact: More epochs = better fit but risk overfitting

dropout.description: Fraction of neurons randomly disabled during training

regularization.impact: Prevents overfitting by penalizing large weights

activationFunctions.relu: max(0, x) - fast, avoids vanishing gradient, most popular
activationFunctions.tanh: (e^x - e^-x)/(e^x + e^-x) - centered at 0, stronger gradients than sigmoid
activationFunctions.leakyRelu: max(αx, x) - allows small negative gradients

architectures.cnn: Convolutional Neural Network - for images, spatial data
architectures.rnn: Recurrent Neural Network - for sequences, time series
architectures.lstm: Long Short-Term Memory - handles long sequences

training: Repeat for epochs with early stopping

complexity.scalability: Excellent with GPUs; distributed training available
